outcome: The Experiment Library is one browse-first discovery surface for Showcase, Mine, Shared and Supervised research
owner_impact: Browse experiments now opens one responsive library whose hierarchy works without search: Showcase is organized by public Showcase collections, Mine by private collections, Shared by owner, and Supervised by researcher then collection. Search remains optional acceleration. The old ordinary Showcase browser is replaced by Professor-only curation, while read-only/copy/editability boundaries remain distinct.

next.text: The approved Experiment-discovery cleanup scope is complete. #273 remains a living UI/UX refinement domain and returns to dormant status with no current executable child. The completed library is available in the live Lab.

technical_evidence: The unified library uses fixed role-aware source navigation and source-specific directories rather than a global All-experiments bucket.

Showcase collections are separate public curation metadata; private Experiment collections remain private, and Professor supervised collection labels are exposed only through an authorization-checked read model.
Shared browsing groups by owner without exposing the owner's private collection structure.
Open loads an Experiment without running it; Open & run is an explicit secondary action in Details.
Production smoke covers browse-first Showcase discovery at phone, foldable, desktop and ultra-wide widths using the shared browser harness.
The retired flat finder is no longer constructed; Browse experiments accessibility/focus and collection refresh wiring target the unified library only.

Responsive Experiment Library production smoke changes phone, foldable, desktop and ultra-wide viewports on one fully ready document, avoiding navigation races while still verifying live responsive behavior.
